_about: Recorded-style sounds generated once with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API (python3 sound/samples_fetch.py) and committed. kind: sfx (one-shot, mono unless stereo: true) or bed (an ambience loop, stereo). level: the default LU relative to the voice (like SFX_REL in build.py).
